upgrade_dialog_intro: This update needs changes to your docker-compose.yml. DumbMonit never edits that file for you: copy each block, apply it, then press Done.
upgrade_dialog_all_intro: Every change a release has asked for, and where this instance stands. A closed change never comes back.
upgrade_dialog_later_hint: A reminder stays in the corner until you dismiss it.
upgrade_dialog_empty: No configuration change has been needed so far.
upgrade_note_still_missing: The check still fails. If you know it is in place, close the change anyway.
upgrade_notice_confirm: Dismiss for good? The list stays in Settings → About.
upgrade_about_text: Changes a release asks for in your docker-compose.yml, such as a port to publish.
